create_crowd_sourced_annotation_graph: create a CrowdSourcedAnnotation BMGraph model with expected correctness and concentration parameters for binary labelers
build_dirichlet_beta_distribution: build a size-2 Dirichlet distribution using the dirichlet helper method equivalent to a Beta distribution and its complement
bind_labels_to_bmgraph: bind an xarray Dataset of labels and labelers to the BMGraph model to add observations for inference
format_inference_samples: format raw numpy inference samples into an xarray Dataset with prev and confusion_matrix dimensions
review_crowd_sourced_annotation_class: review the CrowdSourcedAnnotation class and its confusion matrix prior logic for binary crowd-sourced annotation tasks
